questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At det var et sted og en kultur jeg ikke har oplevet før + naturen og de oplevelser jeg kunne få

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: For mig var det en begrænsning at der nærmest kun blev snakket fransk i Montreal

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Informationen var okay let at finde, det var svære at vide hvilken information jeg behøvede at have

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var ikke nogen hjælp før vi selv opsøgte studievejledere, herefter var de til gengæld meget hjælpsomme

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var okay let, jeg fandt lejlighed igennem diverse facebookgrupper f.eks. 'Housing in Montreal'

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er en del billigere at bo off campus, men man kan godt miste lidt af det sociale med udvekslingsstuderende fra andre lande end DK

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg synes ikke deres systemer er særligt intuitive, specielt det at søge kurser var svært

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man skal slev finde ud af hvilke fag man vil have, så skal man skrive til professoren af det fag der skal godkende dig, herefter kan du søge faget i Minerva og håbe på at der er plads

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Universitets hjemmeside + At snakke med deres studievejleder

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de fag jeg ville have pånær et, som jeg fravalgte da det lå langt fra campus

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Snak med universitets studievejleder! Hav flere fag forberedt som forslag til hvad du gerne vil læse

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet afhænger af hvilke level dine kurser er i, 500 er svært og 350 er omkring det samme niveau som i DK

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der var kun forelæsninger i de fag jeg havde valgt

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Nutrition & Wellness, Adapted Physical Activity, Sport Psychology, Sleep Mechanism & Behaviour

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Sleep Mechanism & Behaviour var for mig enormt spændende, dog akademisk også det sværeste

questions.answer: Alt hvad man køber lægges der tax' oveni, så når man ser en pris i f.eks. supermarkedet er det vist uden tax

questions.answer: Mad koster omkring det samme hvis ikke lidt mere, benzin er en del billigere i DK, ellers ville jeg sige at Canada er dyre end DK

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Man skal være hurtig hvis man vil nå at have en plads på et hold, men fitnesscenter, pool, tennisbane og squash bane var der altid plads i

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er en masse students clubs såsom 'Cheese & wine' (søg på instagram) og så er der motionsmuligheder

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville klart anbefale at leje en bil (igennem Turo) og tage på en masse mindre ture i weekender osv.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Nova Scotia, NY, Toronto, Quebéc City

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var let, føler at det er en storby som hver anden

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Deltag i sociale arrangementer, snak med sidemanden

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Sprogbarrierer ift. fransk

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Interessen i naturen

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at have styr på financer og forsikring, husk også at opleve og nyde landet, være åben for nye muligheder og menneskere

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt kommunikation med kommunen foregår på fransk, f.eks. når man skal have sygesikring

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det sociale bånd jeg har fået udviklet, og den naturoplevelse det var

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Hjemve

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
